fit_model_policy: Adopt exact development model trained on locked fit with unchanged trigger/params; no retraining on held-out data

evaluation.interpretation: Within-dataset paired estimates; extra clean view models only for full; FPR target is not a test guarantee.

process_peak_memory.method: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo; whole process, including native allocations

resources.peak_memory_scope: whole shared process; not attributable to a detector variant

latency.scope: warm single-input detector latency; alternating order, same samples; not isolated RAM comparison

interpretation: Weak/unconfirmed attack cells retained and labeled; detector efficacy claims require independently viable attacks
